describe.description: The creature is shown in side view standing on a small patch of dirt with sparse vegetation. It has a long, low, quadrupedal body with a pale pink, soft and wrinkled underside and limbs and a broad, rounded head with large eyes at the front, while the entire back from the neck to the tip of the long tapering tail is covered in overlapping, glossy brown scales. Six feathery pink stalks project from behind the head, and the animal stands on four short, thick legs ending in clawed feet, with a thick tail extending straight back behind it.

describe.description: A quadrupedal creature shown in side view facing right, standing on a small patch of dirt. It has a broad, pale pink axolotl-like head with a blunt snout and a slight smile, a soft wrinkled pale pink underbody and four short pink limbs, and its entire back from the neck to the tip of its long tapering tail is covered in overlapping brown armor-like scales. Pink feathery external gills protrude from behind the head, and its feet have long slender clawed toes.
